claims.statement: HAK-019a retains exact body bytes plus selected HTTP header field values in a digest-bound response envelope with explicit request/response identities, bounded observation times, exact HAK canonical profile identity, and machine-visible non-claims for provider authentication and raw HTTP wire retention.

HAK-019a deterministically replays rel=next projection from the exact retained Link header field values under the exact content-bound projection policy and executing parser snapshot; relative targets resolve against the exact request URL and accepted continuation targets preserve scheme, authority, API path, and absence of fragments.

HAK-019a rejects tested ambiguous or out-of-profile Link representations including duplicate rel parameters, duplicate next targets, malformed syntax, non-RFC whitespace semantics, cross-origin/path/fragment continuation targets, CRLF header injection, and non-200 projection sources.

HAK-019a keeps provider authentication, raw HTTP wire verification, and collection exhaustion unestablished; absence of rel=next is represented only as no next relation observed, and coherently redigested projection forgeries are rejected by deterministic replay.

required_checks.description: Resolve, checkout, and assert the exact PR head.
Compile the HAK-019a retained-envelope and Link projection tooling.
Validate both HAK-019a JSON Schemas and policy JSON syntax.
Lint the HAK-019a machine-readable qualification plan.
Lint the HAK-019a HAK-010 precommitted obligation-to-step binding policy.
Run focused HAK-019a envelope, strict Link parser, deterministic replay, target-scope, boundary, and schema-parity regressions.

required_negative_cases: Unicode whitespace treated as HTTP OWS
non-200 response accepted for pagination projection
envelope provider authentication promoted after coherent redigest
raw HTTP wire retention promoted after coherent redigest
absent next relation promoted to verified exhaustion
projection provider authentication promoted after coherent redigest
HTTP wire verification promoted after coherent redigest
unknown envelope root field accepted by schema
unknown projection root field accepted by schema
projection schema accepts wrong strengthened policy digest

independence.claim_interpretation: limited to retained response-envelope integrity, exact retained Link-header rel=next projection replay under the committed strict parser/policy, continuation target-scope enforcement, schema parity, and tested anti-oracle boundaries; does not authenticate provider responses, retain raw HTTP wire bytes, prove collection exhaustion, verify body/entity projection, establish temporal snapshot consistency, establish semantic truth, upgrade upstream HAK qualification, or grant runtime authority
